_note: Seasonal monthly shares of annual retail target. Retail/territorial basis only — institutional/tender (Non-territory) business is tender-driven and lumpy and must NOT be seasonalised. Derived from FY2025-26 actuals. SINGLE-YEAR CALIBRATION — not yet validated against a second year. Update annually after each FY completes. Values in the 'monthly' array run Apr=0 … Mar=11 and must sum to 1.0 (code normalises for rounding). Quarterly array: Q1 (Apr-Jun)=0, Q2 (Jul-Sep)=1, Q3 (Oct-Dec)=2, Q4 (Jan-Mar)=3.

versions.derivedFrom: FY2025-26 retail actuals (institutional/Non-territory excluded). Single-year — not yet validated against a second year. Rebuild after FY2026-27 completes.
